decision_boundary: This is a development-only technical pose gate. Passing authorizes docking the frozen 96-ligand PPARD development pilot against every passing receptor without structural max-min compression. It does not establish screening enrichment, functional complementarity, QUBO portability, QUBO superiority, quantum execution, speedup, or quantum advantage. Preparation failures remain failures in the frozen 51-receptor denominator and cannot be replaced.

derivation_rule.center: heavy-atom centroid rounded to two decimals
derivation_rule.size: heavy-atom span plus 12 angstrom, rounded upward to a 2-angstrom increment and clamped to 22-30 angstrom
derivation_rule.source: 2ZNP K55 heavy-atom coordinates in the reference frame
derivation_rule.timing: Frozen in Stage55 before PPARD docking outcomes
